senses.gloss: showing high moral qualities such as honesty, courage, or kindness

definition_translations.zh_TW: 展現誠實、勇氣或善良等高尚品德的

definition_translations.vi_VN: thể hiện phẩm chất đạo đức cao như trung thực, dũng cảm hoặc tử tế

senses.gloss: belonging to a high social rank by birth or title
senses.example: The castle once belonged to a noble family.

example_translations.zh_TW: 這座城堡曾屬於一個貴族家庭。
example_translations.ja_JP: その城はかつて貴族の家系のものだった。
example_translations.ko_KR: 그 성은 한때 귀족 가문의 소유였다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Lâu đài từng thuộc về một gia đình quý tộc.
example_translations.th_TH: ปราสาทแห่งนี้เคยเป็นของตระกูลขุนนาง

definition_translations.zh_TW: 因出身或頭銜而屬於高社會階層的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 生まれや称号により高い社会的地位に属する
definition_translations.ko_KR: 출생이나 칭호로 높은 사회적 지위에 속하는

definition_translations.th_TH: อยู่ในชนชั้นสูงโดยกำเนิดหรือตำแหน่ง

senses.gloss: a person from a high social rank

definition_translations.vi_VN: người thuộc tầng lớp xã hội cao
